source.title: Measurements of heterogeneity in proteomics analysis of the nanoparticle protein corona across core facilities

source_to_cell_map.coordinate_definition: Every output row retains its original Final Prot worksheet row and A:K cell range.
source_to_cell_map.transformation: openpyxl read_only/data_only extraction; no imputation, pooling, relabelling, or biological-label inference.

primary_uses: Quantify between-core detectability, abundance-scale and technical-replicate heterogeneity on identical protein-corona aliquots.
Evaluate whether a preprocessing or harmonization method transfers to held-out proteomics core facilities.
prohibited_uses: Do not describe the 12 semiquantitative core facilities as independent biological cohorts or as independent nanoparticle formulations.
Do not use this source alone to claim material-property prediction, biological out-of-distribution generalization, clinical utility, or external scientific reproduction.
